EARLIER: As of 3:39 PM, hindi na madaanan ng mga sasakyan ang bahagi ng NS Amoranto sa Quezon City dahil sa baha bunsod ng naranasang malakas na ulan ngayong hapon, May 17.

Samantala, bumaha na rin sa kanto ng Banawe at NS Amoranto Street.

Ayon sa PAGASA, nasa ilalim ng thunderstorm advisory ang Quezon City as of 2:40 PM, kung saan maaaring makaranas ng malakas na pag-uulan sa loob ng dalawang oras. | via @luisitosantos03 

Bisitahin ang https://t.co/KqDTBMbTQD para sa iba pang balita.

Localized thunderstorms brought heavy rains over Metro Manila, parts of Luzon, and Mindanao on Saturday, triggering flooding in several areas, the state weather bureau said.

In a report by Jamie Santos on "24 Oras Weekend" on Sunday, heavy rains on Saturday evening caused gutter-deep flooding in Barangay Manuyo Dos in Las Piñas City, forcing residents to wade through floodwaters.
